_description: Starter 9 — Minimal viable KPI set for 1-hour SaaS onboarding. Covers all 6 Power-of-1 ROI metrics, 5 context graph signal sources, 4 of 5 pillars. P4 (Partner) deferred to Growth tier.

_kpi_map.P1-KPI1: DAU Rate — baseline for Signal Analyst, product adoption ROI
_kpi_map.P1-KPI3: TTFV — stalled_deployment arc detection, primary Power-of-1 metric
_kpi_map.P2-KPI1: Exec Sponsor Engagement — STAKEHOLDER nodes, exec_sponsor_change arcs
_kpi_map.P3-KPI1: Ticket Resolution Time — support efficiency, Cost Savings in ROI
_kpi_map.P3-KPI3: NPS — sentiment_decline arc, Wizard C calibration signal
_kpi_map.P3-KPI4: Escalation Rate — crisis_recovery arcs, high-fidelity SIGNAL
_kpi_map.P5-KPI1: NRR — L4 health rollup, EV/Revenue multiple impact
_kpi_map.P5-KPI2: GRR — Wizard C calibration, Churn Prevented dollar impact

accounts.name: Horizon AI Labs
accounts.narrative: Series B AI startup. Onboarded Q4 2025, hit value within 2 weeks. DAU at 72%, NPS 52. Champion (VP Eng) pushing for enterprise license expansion across 3 BUs.

key_signals.content: DAU hit 72% within first month — strong adoption signal
VP Eng requesting licenses for ML Ops and Data Platform teams

accounts.name: Nexus Financial Systems
accounts.narrative: Mid-market fintech. Stable usage, strong exec engagement. NRR at 110%, GRR solid at 90%. Moderate expansion pipeline — looking at API integrations for Q3.

key_signals.content: COO attended QBR and expressed multi-year commitment

accounts.name: CloudBridge Analytics
accounts.narrative: Analytics SaaS. Onboarded 6 months ago, usage stabilized. TTFV was 18 days (good). NPS 42 (borderline). Ticket volume manageable but escalation rate creeping up.

key_signals.content: Escalation rate ticked up from 3% to 5% — monitoring

accounts.name: Velocity Commerce
accounts.narrative: E-commerce platform. VP Product (champion) left in Jan. New head is evaluating alternatives. DAU dropped from 65% to 40%. NPS fell to 28. Exec sponsor disengaged.

key_signals.content: VP Product David Park left the company — key platform champion
DAU dropped from 65% to 40% within 2 weeks of champion departure
New engineering director evaluating Shopify Plus analytics suite

actions.outcome: Identified Lisa Huang as potential new champion
Secured 60-day platform commitment pending value demonstration

accounts.name: MedCore Health Tech
accounts.narrative: Healthcare SaaS. Ticket resolution time ballooned to 48hrs after platform migration. Escalation rate at 12%. NPS crashed from 45 to 18. GRR dropping. Exec sponsor frustrated.

key_signals.content: Ticket resolution time doubled after V3 platform migration
CMIO escalated to CEO — threatening contract review
NPS dropped from 45 to 18 — detractor territory

actions.action: Dedicated support pod assigned — 4hr SLA override
Platform stability review with engineering VP
actions.outcome: Root cause identified — migration rollback plan in place

accounts.name: DataForge Industrial
accounts.narrative: Industrial IoT SaaS. Multiple compounding failures: exec sponsor left, DAU collapsed to 15%, NPS at 5, escalation rate 20%. GRR at 68%. Renewal in 60 days — emergency intervention needed.

key_signals.content: VP Operations Frank Morrison left — exec sponsor and budget holder
DAU collapsed from 58% to 15% — teams stopped logging in
CFO flagged contract for non-renewal review
Engineering team running POC with PTC ThingWorx

actions.action: Emergency C-suite meeting with our CEO
actions.outcome: CFO agreed to 90-day extension pending value demonstration

actions.action: Dedicated CSM + solutions architect assigned full-time
actions.outcome: DAU recovering to 30% with targeted re-onboarding

actions.action: Custom ROI report delivered to CFO showing $2.1M protected
actions.outcome: CFO softened stance — renewal discussion reopened
